versions.changelog:
gmgn-market 1.4.7

- Added Ethereum (ETH) support for K-line and trending commands.
- Introduced the new `market signal` sub-command for real-time token alerts (sol/bsc only).
- Updated default filters: EVM chains now include ETH (`not_honeypot verified renounced`).
- Increased API rate limits (now rate=20, capacity=20).
- Updated setup: use `gmgn-cli config set-key` for configuring API key.
- Expanded and clarified use case descriptions, launchpad coverage, and sub-command documentation.

- Removed support and documentation for Ethereum chain; now only sol, bsc, and base are supported.
- Dropped the "signal" sub-command; "signal" is no longer described or supported.
- Updated argument hints and supported commands to match the reduced feature set.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Description and documentation streamlined and clarified to focus on K-line, trending, and trenches commands only.

- Added Ethereum (ETH) support for price charts and trending token commands.
- Introduced the new `market signal` sub-command to surface real-time token events (price spikes, smart money activity, etc.) on Solana and BSC.
- Updated CLI argument hints and filter defaults to accommodate ETH and new sub-command.
- Documentation updated to reflect expanded supported chains and new features.

gmgn-market 1.2.7 — Changelog

- Updated the skill description for improved clarity and conciseness.
- Simplified supported use cases and command hints.
- No changes to commands, features, or core logic.
- Documentation streamlined for easier understanding.

gmgn-market v1.2.6

- Updated skill description for improved clarity, highlighting charting capability, discovery of trending/hot tokens, and coverage of new token launches across more launchpads (added Raydium, clarified use cases).
- More examples and scenarios now suggested in the description (e.g., "find early-stage opportunities" and "without a specific token address").
- Minor refinements for accuracy and broader user query matching.
- No changes to command usage or technical behavior.

- Added support for fourmeme launchpad tokens to the description.
- No other file changes detected.

gmgn-market 1.2.4 changelog

- Improved skill description for clarity, explicitly mentioning launchpad support and common crypto user intents (e.g., candlestick charts, trending tokens, new launches).
- Added more user-oriented trigger phrases/suggestions to the description (e.g., "price history", "OHLCV", "early-stage token opportunities").
- No logic or API changes. Only SKILL.md (documentation/metadata) updated for better discoverability and user guidance.

gmgn-market 1.2.3

- Added detailed rate-limit handling instructions, including response headers, cooldown messaging, and retry timing for 429 errors.
- Clarified chain filter defaults and fixed filter documentation inconsistencies.
- Updated skill description for accuracy and conciseness.
- Improved prerequisites and first-time setup instructions.
- Minor wording and structure improvements for clarity.
Initial release. Supports realtime price chart (kline/candlestick), trending token discovery, and Trenches new launch lists on Solana, BNB Chain, and Base Chain.
